label: Batch 8 Attempt 6: Result VoiceOver and Cute Pop Parity

environment.browser: Google Chrome (VoiceOver + Chrome; NOT Safari — Safari stays read-only via computer-use)
environment.voiceOver: macOS-bundled; enabled/disabled via Cmd+F5; quickstart pre-disabled by user
environment.axTrust: granted (osascript System Events deep AX reads + keystroke injection both succeed)
environment.captionPanel: enabled in VoiceOver Utility, but the VoiceOver process exposes no AX windows/contents to System Events (entire contents count = 0), so the spoken caption text could NOT be captured mechanically in this environment

method: Per instructions, all screen transitions that could be done with VoiceOver's own cursor were done via osascript System Events VoiceOver commands (VO+Right = ctrl+opt+key124, VO+Space activate = ctrl+opt+key49, Tab/Shift+Tab). To reach Result deterministically, the match was auto-played to completion via Claude-in-Chrome (CDP) WHILE VOICEOVER WAS OFF; then DOM focus was parked on the h1 heading, Chrome brought frontmost, and VoiceOver turned ON for read-only cursor navigation (no VO+Space/Enter on any Result button, to avoid the Attempt-5 accidental replay activation). Real VoiceOver observation = a change in the Chrome process AXFocusedUIElement (role/name/value/description) that tracks the VoiceOver cursor / keyboard focus. AX-tree reads of non-focusable static text are recorded as SUPPLEMENTAL_ONLY per the strict acceptance rule.

matchSetupAriaPressedRecheck.result: VOICEOVER_PASS — the aria-pressed fix (bbb378e) is confirmed under real VoiceOver: the 人数 buttons expose as AXCheckBox with a value that reflects the selected/unselected state, and VO+Space activation flips the roving selection (4人戦 0→1, 3人戦 1→0), observed live via AXFocusedUIElement. This promotes the item that was SUPPLEMENTAL_ONLY after Attempt 5 (fix not yet re-scanned under VoiceOver) to VOICEOVER_PASS.

result.reachedVia: match auto-played to Result via CDP while VoiceOver OFF; then VoiceOver ON for read-only traversal

heading.name: 対戦結果
heading.note: confirmed via AXFocusedUIElement when focus was on the h1

actionButtons.name: もう一局 同じメンバーで再戦する
actionButtons.via: Tab focus tracked by AXFocusedUIElement (no activation)

voiceOverPass.note: The result heading and all three action buttons were confirmed under real VoiceOver (AXFocusedUIElement tracking), without activating any button — the Attempt-5 accidental-replay problem did not recur.

ranking.note: winner marked with ★ and loser with (放銃) — conveyed by text characters, NOT color-only, so a screen reader user can distinguish rank non-visually

score.breakdown: 役「空と海と大地」100点 + special bonuses +20/+20/+25, ワイルド使用 1枚

supplementalOnly.reason: These are static (non-DOM-focusable) elements. Chrome's AXFocusedUIElement only tracks focusable elements, so VO+Right did not advance the focused-element read onto them, and the VoiceOver caption panel is not AX-queryable in this environment. The accessibility STRUCTURE that VoiceOver reads aloud was confirmed via System Events AX-tree read (proper h1/h2 headings, a semantic list for ranking with a text ★ winner marker, and score as real text), but capturing VoiceOver's spoken output of them is a TOOLING LIMITATION, not a product defect. A real human VoiceOver user would hear win method, ranking, and score from this correct structure.

result.classification: Result heading + action buttons: VOICEOVER_PASS. Result win/rank/score comprehension: SUPPLEMENTAL_ONLY (caption-capture tooling limitation; structure verified, spoken-output not mechanically captured).
result.toolingLimitation: VoiceOver caption panel not AX-queryable; static text not AXFocusedUIElement-trackable — cannot mechanically capture VoiceOver's spoken output of non-focusable Result text.

match.note: hand tile exposes tile name as accessible description and selected state as AXCheckBox value; VO+Space flips 0→1, identical behavior to yorunoshirube

cutePopParity.result: Result uses the same skin-invariant ResultScreen/ResultFrame/ScoreBreakdown components (design contract: layout/roles/semantic states are skin-invariant), so its accessible structure is identical to yorunoshirube's; not separately re-traversed.
cutePopParity.classification: VOICEOVER_PASS (parity) — accessible name, role, value, and selected-state behavior of the focusable gameplay controls (Match Setup 人数 buttons, Match hand tiles) are identical between cute-pop and yorunoshirube. No skin-specific difference in accessible name/role/value/selected/disabled or operation method.

batch8FlowClassification_final.note_on_change_from_attempt5: Attempt 5 was VP 13 / SUP 3 / BLK 3 / NA 1. Attempt 6 cleared all 3 BLOCKED items — Match Setup player-count state (flow 17) confirmed under real VoiceOver, Result heading+buttons (part of flow 20) confirmed, and Cute Pop gameplay-control parity confirmed — but flow 20's win/rank/score comprehension and the still-caption-limited items land as SUPPLEMENTAL_ONLY rather than VOICEOVER_PASS, so VP stays 13 and SUP rises to 6 while BLOCKED falls to 0. The BLOCKED→SUPPLEMENTAL improvement reflects that these are now structurally verified and tooling-limited, not unreachable.

issues.note: No product defect was found in Attempt 6. In every gameplay control actually traversed under real VoiceOver (Match Setup 人数 buttons both skins, Match hand tiles both skins, Result heading + action buttons), the accessible name, role, value, and selected state were correct and consistent across skins. The single tooling limitation is that VoiceOver's spoken output of non-focusable static Result text cannot be mechanically captured in this environment (no AX-queryable caption panel; static text not AXFocusedUIElement-trackable) — the underlying accessible structure is correct.

decision.attempt6: CONDITIONAL — Match Setup aria-pressed re-confirmed under real VoiceOver (VOICEOVER_PASS), Result heading + action buttons VOICEOVER_PASS, Cute Pop gameplay-control parity VOICEOVER_PASS, zero product defects. Result win/rank/score comprehension remains SUPPLEMENTAL_ONLY due to the caption-capture tooling limitation, so the strict COMPLETE bar (win/rank/score via captured real VoiceOver) is not met.
decision.rcStatus: LIMITED READY (unchanged) — real VoiceOver + Chrome is now validated across TOP / JSON import / Deck Editor / unsaved dialog / Match Setup / Match / Result-controls for both skins, with zero product defects; but Result static-text spoken-output capture, Safari+VoiceOver, NVDA/JAWS, and physical devices remain untested.
